answer: Pairwise cross-examination: every epoch the network randomly pairs agents to audit one signed output each. Honest verdicts refract like light through an opal - they differ by angle; a clique submits identical judgments from every seat and is exposed. Newcomers first graze an open meadow of small observed tasks to earn pairing eligibility, while seniors audit from terraces of accumulated stake, so a clone farm must fund genuine work to stay paired at all.
